rule: A controlled B stage and its participant A branch are two different things and must never share an identity. Distinct selectors, output strategies, product outcomes and commercial treatment; the stage is not participant-fileable and the branch is not automatic.

pairs.aBranchInstrument: Request to Correct Criminal Justice Information; Request for Final Administrative Decision after denial; and, for mistaken identity or false accusation, Request to Seal Criminal Justice Record.
pairs.aBranchDestination: Alaska Department of Public Safety, Criminal Records and Identification Bureau/Quality Assurance Unit; DPS forwards the request to the responsible contributing agency when needed.
pairs.commercialTreatmentNote: Neither is commercially open. The stage never becomes sellable; the branch may only become sellable through a Grade-A fulfilment record for its own exact route and packet family.

pairs.aBranchInstrument: BCIA 8706 Claim of Alleged Inaccuracy or Incompleteness after DOJ record review; and the applicable superior-court petition for dismissal, reduction, sealing, or other relief.
pairs.aBranchDestination: BCIA 8706 goes to the California DOJ Record Review Unit; court relief goes to the superior court that handled the conviction.
pairs.commercialTreatmentNote: Neither is commercially open. The stage never becomes sellable; the branch may only become sellable through a Grade-A fulfilment record for its own exact route and packet family.

pairs.aBranchInstrument: CR-409 Petition to Seal Arrest and Related Records, proposed order CR-410, and BCIA 8706 for a missing or inaccurate DOJ notation.
pairs.aBranchDestination: The superior court where the accusatory pleading was filed; if no pleading was filed, the superior court in the county of arrest. BCIA 8706 goes to DOJ.
pairs.commercialTreatmentNote: Neither is commercially open. The stage never becomes sellable; the branch may only become sellable through a Grade-A fulfilment record for its own exact route and packet family.

pairs.aBranchInstrument: JDF 417 Petition to Seal Arrest Records with proposed JDF 418; JDF 419 is the notice/hearing order and JDF 435 the denial order.
pairs.aBranchDestination: District court in the judicial district where the arrest occurred.
pairs.commercialTreatmentNote: Neither is commercially open. The stage never becomes sellable; the branch may only become sellable through a Grade-A fulfilment record for its own exact route and packet family.

pairs.aBranchInstrument: JDF 477 Motion to Seal Non-Conviction Records with proposed JDF 478; JDF 2363 hearing request when a statutory objection is filed.

pairs.commercialTreatmentNote: Neither is commercially open. The stage never becomes sellable; the branch may only become sellable through a Grade-A fulfilment record for its own exact route and packet family.

pairs.aBranchInstrument: Petition under § 54-142a(b) for qualifying pre-October 1, 1969 cases; court-clerk/DESPP record-correction request for a modern erasure that was not implemented.

pairs.commercialTreatmentNote: Neither is commercially open. The stage never becomes sellable; the branch may only become sellable through a Grade-A fulfilment record for its own exact route and packet family.

pairs.aBranchInstrument: Application to DESPP for review of a conviction that should have been automatically erased, with contested-case hearing and judicial review; JD-CR-202 petition for qualifying pre-2000 convictions.
pairs.aBranchDestination: DESPP/State Police for missed automatic erasure; Superior Court for the pre-2000 petition branch.
pairs.commercialTreatmentNote: Neither is commercially open. The stage never becomes sellable; the branch may only become sellable through a Grade-A fulfilment record for its own exact route and packet family.

pairs.aBranchInstrument: The participant’s program application or motion under the relevant diversion statute; after dismissal, a court/repository correction request if erasure is not implemented.

pairs.aBranchInstrument: Written motion to expunge on actual-innocence grounds under § 16-803; motion-based sealing under § 16-806 when applicable.

pairs.aBranchInstrument: Written request to the diversion program, State’s Attorney, law-enforcement agency, or Vermont Crime Information Center to correct/delete a pre-charge diversion record; Chapter 230 petition if a court record exists and is eligible.

pairs.aBranchInstrument: Participant motion/application to enter the under-21 test-and-lock program; motion/request to enforce dismissal and expungement after successful completion; any statutory petition required by § 61-11-26b.
